title: Normalize
description: Scales the sound to a target peak or a target integrated loudness (never past -0.1 dBFS): a very quiet recording needs no hand-found gain.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the sound through untouched (bypass).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.doc: peak scales the loudest sample to the peak target; loudness scales to the loudness target (LUFS).

parameters.name: peak
parameters.doc: The peak the loudest sample is brought to in peak mode.

parameters.name: loudness
parameters.doc: The integrated loudness the sound is brought to in loudness mode.

parameters.name: max_gain
parameters.doc: The most that may be added, so that silence with a bit of noise is not lifted to full scale.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).
